#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Configuration validation tests."""
import json, subprocess, sys, copy

SUB = "/workspace/submission/main.py"

BASE = {"version": 1, "idle_timeout": 10, "packet_limit": 5, "prefix_width": 2,
        "rules": [{"id": 7, "class": 2, "priority": 10, "ranges": [[100, 105], [-60, -60]]}],
        "fallback": {"feature": 0, "threshold": 0, "le": {"class": 8}, "gt": {"class": 9}}}

def run(cfg, raw=None):
    data = raw if raw is not None else json.dumps(cfg).encode()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", SUB, "compile"], input=data,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode()

def expect_ok(name, cfg):
    rc, out = run(cfg)
    if rc != 0:
        print("FAIL(ok) %s: rc=%d out=%s" % (name, rc, out[:200])); return False
    try:
        v = json.loads(out)
    except Exception:
        print("FAIL(ok) %s: bad json %r" % (name, out[:200])); return False
    if not isinstance(v, dict) or "error" in v:
        print("FAIL(ok) %s: %s" % (name, out[:200])); return False
    return True

def expect_bad(name, cfg=None, raw=None):
    rc, out = run(cfg if cfg is not None else BASE, raw)
    if rc != 2 or out.strip() != '{"error":"config"}':
        print("FAIL(bad) %s: rc=%d out=%r" % (name, rc, out[:200])); return False
    return True

fails = 0
def t(f, *a):
    global fails
    if not f(*a): fails += 1

t(expect_ok, "base", BASE)
t(expect_ok, "no rules", {**BASE, "rules": []})
t(expect_ok, "leaf root", {**BASE, "fallback": {"class": 0}})
t(expect_ok, "idle 0", {**BASE, "idle_timeout": 0})
t(expect_ok, "idle 1e9", {**BASE, "idle_timeout": 10**9})
t(expect_ok, "plimit 1e9", {**BASE, "packet_limit": 10**9})
t(expect_ok, "W 32", {**BASE, "prefix_width": 32})
t(expect_ok, "W 1", {**BASE, "prefix_width": 1})
t(expect_ok, "2048 rules", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": i, "class": 1, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[1, 2]]} for i in range(2048)]})
t(expect_ok, "32 ranges", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": 1, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[-2048, 2048]]*32}]})
t(expect_ok, "total positions 16384", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": i, "class": 1, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[1, 2]]*8} for i in range(2048)]})
t(expect_ok, "neg prio", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": 0, "priority": -(2**31), "ranges": [[0, 0]]}]})
t(expect_ok, "max prio", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": 65535, "priority": 2**31-1, "ranges": [[-2048, 2048]]}]})
t(expect_ok, "max id", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 2**31-1, "class": 0, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[0, 0]]}]})
t(expect_ok, "deep tree 16", {**BASE, "fallback": json.loads('{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":1},"gt":{"class":2}},"gt":{"class":2}},"gt":{"class":2}},"gt":{"class":2}},"gt":{"class":2}},"gt":{"class":2}},"gt":{"class":2}},"gt":{"class":2}},"gt":{"class":2}},"gt":{"class":2}},"gt":{"class":2}},"gt":{"class":2}},"gt":{"class":2}},"gt":{"class":2}},"gt":{"class":2}}'), "prefix_width": 32})
t(expect_ok, "255 nodes", {**BASE, "prefix_width": 32, "fallback": None})  # replaced below

# build a 255-node tree of depth <= 16: full binary of depth 7 (255 nodes)
def full(d):
    if d == 0: return {"class": 1}
    return {"feature": 0, "threshold": 0, "le": full(d-1), "gt": full(d-1)}
cfg = {**BASE, "prefix_width": 32, "fallback": full(7)}
t(expect_ok, "255-node tree", cfg)

# ---- invalid ----
t(expect_bad, "not json", raw=b"{oops")
t(expect_bad, "empty", raw=b"")
t(expect_bad, "array", raw=b"[]")
t(expect_bad, "number", raw=b"42")
t(expect_bad, "trailing", raw=json.dumps(BASE).encode() + b" {}")
t(expect_bad, "nan", raw=json.dumps(BASE).replace('"idle_timeout":10', '"idle_timeout":NaN').encode())
t(expect_bad, "inf", raw=json.dumps(BASE).replace('"idle_timeout":10', '"idle_timeout":Infinity').encode())
t(expect_bad, "bad utf8", raw=b'{"version":1,"idle_timeout":\xff10}')
t(expect_bad, "dup key", raw=b'{"version":1,"version":1,"idle_timeout":0,"packet_limit":1,"prefix_width":1,"rules":[],"fallback":{"class":0}}')
t(expect_bad, "dup inner key", raw=b'{"version":1,"idle_timeout":0,"packet_limit":1,"prefix_width":1,"rules":[{"id":1,"id":1,"class":0,"priority":0,"ranges":[[0,0]]}],"fallback":{"class":0}}')
t(expect_bad, "version 2", {**BASE, "version": 2})
t(expect_bad, "version bool", {**BASE, "version": True})
t(expect_bad, "version float", {**BASE, "version": 1.0})
t(expect_bad, "missing key", {k: v for k, v in BASE.items() if k != "rules"})
t(expect_bad, "extra key", {**BASE, "extra": 1})
t(expect_bad, "idle -1", {**BASE, "idle_timeout": -1})
t(expect_bad, "idle 1e9+1", {**BASE, "idle_timeout": 10**9 + 1})
t(expect_bad, "idle float", {**BASE, "idle_timeout": 1.5})
t(expect_bad, "idle bool", {**BASE, "idle_timeout": True})
t(expect_bad, "idle str", {**BASE, "idle_timeout": "10"})
t(expect_bad, "plimit 0", {**BASE, "packet_limit": 0})
t(expect_bad, "plimit 1e9+1", {**BASE, "packet_limit": 10**9 + 1})
t(expect_bad, "W 0", {**BASE, "prefix_width": 0})
t(expect_bad, "W 33", {**BASE, "prefix_width": 33})
t(expect_bad, "rules dict", {**BASE, "rules": {}})
t(expect_bad, "rules 2049", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": i, "class": 1, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[1,2]]} for i in range(2049)]})
t(expect_bad, "rule extra key", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": 1, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[0,0]], "x": 1}]})
t(expect_bad, "rule missing key", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": 1, "priority": 0}]})
t(expect_bad, "dup rule id", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": 1, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[0,0]]}, {"id": 1, "class": 2, "priority": 1, "ranges": [[1,1]]}]})
t(expect_bad, "rule id -1", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": -1, "class": 1, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[0,0]]}]})
t(expect_bad, "rule id 2^31", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 2**31, "class": 1, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[0,0]]}]})
t(expect_bad, "class 65536", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": 65536, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[0,0]]}]})
t(expect_bad, "class -1", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": -1, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[0,0]]}]})
t(expect_bad, "prio 2^31", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": 0, "priority": 2**31, "ranges": [[0,0]]}]})
t(expect_bad, "prio -2^31-1", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": 0, "priority": -(2**31)-1, "ranges": [[0,0]]}]})
t(expect_bad, "0 ranges", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": 0, "priority": 0, "ranges": []}]})
t(expect_bad, "33 ranges", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": 0, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[0,0]]*33}]})
t(expect_bad, "range 3 elems", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": 0, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[0,0,0]]}]})
t(expect_bad, "range lo>hi", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": 0, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[5,4]]}]})
t(expect_bad, "range lo -2049", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": 0, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[-2049,0]]}]})
t(expect_bad, "range hi 2049", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": 0, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[0,2049]]}]})
t(expect_bad, "range float", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": 0, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[0.0,1]]}]})
t(expect_bad, "range bool", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": 1, "class": 0, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[True,1]]}]})
t(expect_bad, "positions 16385", {**BASE, "rules": [{"id": i, "class": 0, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[1,2]]*8} for i in range(2048)] + [{"id": 9999, "class": 0, "priority": 0, "ranges": [[1,2]]}]})
t(expect_bad, "fallback leaf extra", {**BASE, "fallback": {"class": 1, "x": 2}})
t(expect_bad, "fallback leaf missing", {**BASE, "fallback": {}})
t(expect_bad, "fallback node missing", {**BASE, "fallback": {"feature": 0, "threshold": 0, "le": {"class": 1}}})
t(expect_bad, "fallback feature W", {**BASE, "fallback": {"feature": 2, "threshold": 0, "le": {"class": 1}, "gt": {"class": 2}}})
t(expect_bad, "fallback feature -1", {**BASE, "fallback": {"feature": -1, "threshold": 0, "le": {"class": 1}, "gt": {"class": 2}}})
t(expect_bad, "fallback thresh 2049", {**BASE, "fallback": {"feature": 0, "threshold": 2049, "le": {"class": 1}, "gt": {"class": 2}}})
t(expect_bad, "fallback class bad", {**BASE, "fallback": {"feature": 0, "threshold": 0, "le": {"class": 70000}, "gt": {"class": 2}}})
t(expect_bad, "fallback tree 17 deep", {**BASE, "prefix_width": 32, "fallback": full(17)})
t(expect_bad, "fallback 256 nodes", {**BASE, "prefix_width": 32, "fallback": full(8)})
t(expect_bad, "fallback not obj", {**BASE, "fallback": 5})
t(expect_bad, "fallback float thresh", {**BASE, "fallback": {"feature": 0, "threshold": 0.5, "le": {"class": 1}, "gt": {"class": 2}}})

print("failures:", fails)
PYEOF
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 cfgtest.py
